title: Full-history secret scan with a negative drill
summary: Adds gitleaks (binary) to the tool lock, `.gitleaks.toml`, the blocking `secrets` job (full history) to `security.yml`, and `bin/test-security-gates.sh` proving that a synthetic secret is detected.
why: P1 A07: `.env.example` cleanliness does not prove the history is clean. Hard risk: a real secret in history cannot be fixed by an allowlist — stop, report to the owner (rotation first), never rewrite history without an owner decision.

include: `.gitleaks.toml` per knowledge/security-gates#secrets (default rules + narrow, commented allowlist)
`security.yml` job `secrets` (`Secret history scan`): checkout `fetch-depth: 0`, `persist-credentials: false`; runs the full-history scan and `bash bin/test-security-gates.sh`
`bin/test-security-gates.sh`: synthetic key in a temp dir outside the repo, gitleaks `dir` mode must exit 1; trap removes the dir

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence

rules: Never print a detected secret in evidence: use `--redact`.
The synthetic key is generated at runtime and never written inside the repository.
guidance: gitleaks v8 commands: `gitleaks git [--log-opts=...] <path>` and `gitleaks dir <path>`; exit 1 when leaks are found.

validation.procedure: Push (gate CI-PUSH); ci-runs check including Security

result.notes: 8575 findings triaged: 8561 plan digests allowlisted by path+rule, 14 by fingerprint; V4 live waits CI-PUSH
